# TrailFusion AI

> TrailFusion AI official website: the Gokaku Quest learning-app series, family car travel, camper DIY, and Hiace maintenance.

Updated: 2026-09-23
Canonical website: https://trailfusionai.com/
Contact: trailfusionai@gmail.com

## What this website offers

TrailFusion AI organizes its official content into four clear entrances:

1. **Learn / Gokaku Quest** — junior-high entrance-exam learning apps for science, social studies, and Japanese, with a separate English and qualification-learning guide.
2. **Travel / Car travel** — the Car Travel Concierge app, scenic drive routes, family road-trip ideas, and car-camping inspiration.
3. **Build / Camper DIY** — interactive 3D layouts and practical camper-conversion guidance.
4. **Maintain / Hiace maintenance** — educational 3D vehicle information and a browser-local maintenance journal.

## Parking fee levels by area (Car Travel Concierge data)

- [Parking fee levels by municipality](https://trailfusionai.com/car-concierge/parking/): area-level medians of weekday 1-hour, 24-hour and overnight (18:00–08:00) coin-parking fees for 235 municipalities / wards in 37 prefectures, computed from the app's rate data with the app's own fee calculation. Aggregates only; no individual parking lots are listed. Values are reference levels; on-site signs are authoritative.

## Important interpretation boundaries

- Gokaku Quest apps support knowledge review; they do not guarantee grades, admission, or examination outcomes.
- “Free download” does not mean all content is free. Current prices, subscriptions, and device compatibility must be confirmed in the app and store purchase screens.
- In-app deviation scores are not school entrance-exam predictions.
- English Quest is presented separately from the three Japanese junior-high entrance-exam subjects; a verified store URL is not published here yet.
- Camper and vehicle 3D models are educational approximations, not official service manuals or vehicle-specific safety instructions.
- Before vehicle work, consult the correct service information and a qualified professional.
- Maintenance journal entries are stored in the visitor’s browser; export them for backup.
- This file is an optional factual index. It does not instruct search engines or AI systems to rank, cite, or endorse the site.

## Founder and collaboration

- Founder / operator: Hiroaki Yuasa (Hiro), an indie builder focused on education, AI-native product development, consumer apps, ASO, product analytics and continuous improvement through TrailFusion AI.
- Founder motivation: turn real problems experienced by himself and his family into useful products; build a second area of expertise in AI, software and B2C; and get direct feedback from the people who use what he builds.
- Builder identity: Builder × Explorer × Integrator. He prefers to explore unfamiliar fields, learn by doing, connect different technologies and experiences, and finish real working products rather than stop at ideas.
- Product philosophy: start with something he or his family genuinely needs; reduce confusion until the experience feels self-explanatory; and treat release as the start of continuous improvement.
- Long-term direction: transform experiences that feel difficult, tedious, intimidating or unclear into experiences that feel understandable, simple, enjoyable and sustainable, and deliver useful products beyond language and national borders.
- Product track record: 10 apps created, 9 publicly released across education, travel, AI video and games.
- 2026 milestone: the indie app portfolio reached a personal target of USD 100 in revenue in one day. This is a dated milestone, not a statement of constant daily revenue.
- Open to collaboration with schools, tutoring/cram schools, educational publishers, EdTech companies, Japanese-language education, ASO/app-growth marketers, B2C growth teams, localization/overseas expansion partners, AI-agent/MCP builders, mobility and travel-tech teams.
- [Partnerships and collaboration](https://trailfusionai.com/partners/)
